# Convert QR text to UTF-8 bytes before calling the foreign encoder

Historical entry 988 passed text directly to the imported generator. Selected context-only entry 1164 changes that boundary to MailStringUtils.stringToByteString and adds a multibyte snapshot task. The accepted helper uses TextEncoder, and the current QR renderer retains the conversion. Treat text-versus-byte input as a dependency contract. The selected foreign boundary was read, but no complete generator algorithm audit, QR decode or Android scan was run.

Scope: mail/modules/QRExport.sys.mjs.
